audience: Control Plane operators and remote exec-server integrators
candidate_text: Codex remote exec now preserves selected environment cwd as `PathUri` and uses the remote environment shell for unified exec. That matters for cross-OS app-server flows such as Windows remote exec. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/28122
caveats: Keep the claim scoped to selected turn environment cwd and unified exec shell selection.
Do not imply all permission-request paths are now foreign-environment aware.

claims.text: Codex now preserves non-local selected environment cwd as a PathUri.
Remote unified exec shell selection is a Control Plane compatibility concern.

decision.reason: The merged PR has a concrete remote-exec compatibility angle with source-backed app-server and test evidence.

evidence_notes: Remote primary cwd is preserved instead of rewritten to the local fallback.
Unified exec uses the selected environment shell, with Windows test coverage through `pwsh.exe`.
next_steps: Let Publisher automation decide whether to reserve or publish this candidate.
